Estimate plan-enabled capacity

Source: R/yield.R
estimate_capacity.Rd

Turns each site's building envelope into floor area (residential and business) and dwellings, by the path its zone's method sets:

Usage

estimate_capacity(
  x,
  envelope = NULL,
  baseline = NULL,
  conversion = NULL,
  ...,
  .height_bonus = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

A scenario().

envelope

Optional envelope from build_envelopes() for x, to avoid rebuilding it.

baseline

Optional earlier plancap_capacity: sites whose inputs are unchanged are copied (see build_envelopes()).

conversion

Optional conversion() overriding the rulebook's.

...

Passed to build_envelopes().

.height_bonus

Internal: whether to evaluate height bonuses (the second, bonus run sets this to FALSE).

Value

A plancap_capacity object: sites (sf, one row per site, every site kept, with floor area, dwellings, the path and binding constraints and flags), stack (per storey, with the residential and business split), the envelope, the rulebook, the conversion used and a report.

Details

  • volumetric: floor area from the envelope, split between residential and business by the zone's use, and residential floor area converted to dwellings by the rulebook's conversion();

  • density: dwellings straight from the density rule (dwellings per hectare, land per dwelling, or the vacant-site minimum), at least one on an existing lot;

  • hybrid: both, the lesser counts;

  • large sites (at least defaults$large_site$threshold): dwellings by the land less the infrastructure deduction over a land area per dwelling, where the rulebook gives one (large_site$method = "divisor", or any density zone); envelope sites over the threshold take the deduction on their envelope's dwellings.

Then, in this order: floor area ratio and maximum site floorspace (capping the stack from the ground up), no dwellings on a site whose envelope holds no floor (unless a water yard emptied it) or whose land overlays removed, maximum dwellings per site, the access width cap, minor dwellings (their own column), area totals (a precinct's dwelling cap), and entitlements (a minimum guaranteed by law, applied as a floor). Bonuses are reported apart, in *_with_bonus columns.

Results are plan-enabled, gross, blank-slate: what the rules allow if no buildings existed, before feasibility or take-up.

Examples

town <- exampleton()
sc <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
  parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ][1:80, ],
  roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
  zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "transit")])
cap <- estimate_capacity(sc)
cap
#> <plancap capacity> Operative: 80 sites, 116,312 m2 floor area (97,112 m2
#> residential), 1,012 dwellings (+0 minor).
#> Plan-enabled, gross, blank-slate capacity; dwellings at 78 m2 and 85%
#> efficiency.
#> Paths: volumetric 80.
#> With bonuses: +1 dwellings.
